stream: connect (the gameplay layer: making all area reachable)
creator: "Sunny Castle is good enough. But still some flags we talked about before, like making all area reachable and more dynamic activities like PvP throwing explosions and rag dolls." (this stream: the reachable part; PvP is the designer step's)

measured.how: the walk grid's regions (worlds/walk.mjs walk.regions: ground the seats cannot get to and traps they cannot leave, strongly connected; window.__game.regions()) read in GPU Chrome at the start of play, judged as gate D's reach leg judges them (worlds/connect.mjs judgeAreas). 'Before' is the same world with config/world.json reach.connect false.
measured.sunnyCastleAsPlayed: the copy of the composed level the creator played (kit before this stream): 53 regions out of the seats' reach; the one worth going to was the west island, 472 m² with four castle-wall ruins, palms, pines and a crate, 14.1 m of water from the seats' ground (no bridge). The generator's own analysis found more: the two bridged islands and the ring under the castle's plateau were traps (a player who dropped off the plateau to walk to them could never climb back).
measured.sunnyCastleNow: a pad from the plateau to the east island and back, a pad from the south ring back up, the level's own arched bridge to the west island (with earthen approaches onto its deck); every area worth going to reached; caves the colliders' grid reads under cliffs reported, not failed

freshFromPrompt.how: the kit's own headless loop (gamesfun build) from one prompt each, stopped by its own process group when it reached the build round (ledger, foundation, pitch, spec, create and the look done by the loop, nothing hand-edited); the world is what create made; the game copies were then served with create's stub rules (the build round had not run). Copies made without the loop's state folder.

islands.world: terrain islands (spec world.reach written by the spec round)
islands.before: 3 regions worth going to out of reach (the east island 311 m² and the west island 266 m² across 12.4 m and 10.6 m of water; the lower ground holding seat 2, a trap) and the seats split
islands.after: 0; connectors: 2 land bridges (the ground's own arched deck), a ramp back up from the lower ground, a ramp cut into the fort's court
islands.walked: a scripted player with real keys (W A S D relative to the view, routed by window.__game.routeTo) walked to the west island over the bridge in 10.9 s and back up the ramp in 17.2 s, to the east island in 17.7 s and back in 23.3 s, into the fort in 2.7 s
